messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick ask: we need an enablement pack for Azure + GCP marketplace — ref arch, provider-specific Terraform modules, and one-click example templates. Goal: PR by next Wednesday. Who can own modules?
kevin-solutions: I can own TF modules. Plan: separate modules per cloud, small common docs repo. Features: private VPC, KMS wiring, GPU SKU param, optional autoscaler.
olivia-eng-platform: I'll draft the reference architecture and include PlantUML diagram. Two patterns: single-zone GPU pool and multi-region fallback.
sachin-cloud-eng: I'll add startup scripts and kernel/driver notes for GPU images. Also a tiny smoke test that SSHs and curls /healthz. Example snippet for GCP module: `module "redwood_gcp" { source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-templates//modules/gcp" project = var.project machine_type = "a2-highgpu-1g" }`
jen-marketing: Marketing needs: 1-slide arch, 2 screenshots (deploy + console), and a 2-sentence partner blurb. Can engineering supply a stable example by EOD Tuesday?
maria-partnerships: Timeline: Olivia (refarch) Tue, Kevin (TF scaffold) Wed, Sachin (startup + smoke) Wed, Jen (blurb + slides). I'll coordinate legal for dataflow bullets.
kevin-solutions: Repo/CI plan: `partner-templates` repo, branch `tf-scaffold`, GH Actions matrix to deploy to ephemeral test accounts for GCP/Azure, run smoke curl, teardown. PR will include README, examples/, vars.tf, outputs.tf.
olivia-eng-platform: Add `reference-variables.md` and `security-considerations.md` to docs. I'll include variable defaults and required flags.
sachin-cloud-eng: Smoke test example: `ssh -i $KEY ubuntu@$IP "nvidia-smi && curl -s http://localhost:8080/healthz"`
maria-partnerships: Great. We'll meet Friday 10am to review merge and demo. Please tag me on PRs.
